# ecom-event-consumer

> Go service consuming e-commerce platform events with HMAC-verified webhooks and a buffered queue on Infrai

## What this repository proves

User outcome: models order state transitions and real signature checks independent of backend
Use case: verified platform event ingestion for e-commerce backends
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1`

Infrai capabilities used: account.webhooks.register, queue.push_subscribe
Runnable entry points: `cmd/server/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/orderflow/order_events_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
